notes: Medium (sum 7). The mailing-list mapping must be declared in the canonical postfix virtual-alias file at the exact fixed path /etc/postfix/virtual, registered in main.cf (virtual_alias_maps/virtual_alias_domains), compiled with postmap, and summarized in a JSON manifest. Adversarial requirements: specs tolerate comments/blank lines/padded whitespace, the list domain is derived from the spec (hidden specs use different domains), and re-provisioning must replace the previous mapping so stale addresses no longer resolve (append-only or wrong-path configs fail). Delivered as an idempotent executable provisioning script the verifier re-runs on hidden specs.
